page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.6xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine provisioned via the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a nominal clock speed of 3.2 GHz. Compute resources comprise 24 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 96.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core. The configuration includes no GPU accelerators.

Network connectivity is provisioned at a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. The instance does not bundle local storage disks, requiring external cloud block storage for operating system images and persistent data.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory balance yields consistent compute and memory resource availability without oversubscription. System designs must account for network-attached storage latency and throughput constraints. This hardware balance is appropriate for container clusters, backend business logic, continuous integration runners, and mid-tier database hosting.
